title: 残響のコート ―眠らない街の咆哮―
author: 甲斐 走

en.title: Echoes of the Court: Roar of the Sleepless City
en.premise: In the back alleys of a city that never sleeps, a single "lost letter" is discovered. It is a challenge issued by a legendary player who once dominated the local courts, addressed to a future challenger. Guided by the letter, a young boy sets his sights on the top of the street scene, throwing himself into a grueling tournament fueled by sweat and passion. The sheer tenacity of those who have tasted defeat burns through the night on the court.

zh.title: 残响之球场 ——不夜城的咆哮——
zh.premise: 在不夜城的后巷中，一封“失落的信件”被意外发现。那是曾统治这座城市球场的传奇选手，写给未来挑战者的挑战书。循着信件的指引，少年为了登顶街头，毅然投身于一场充满汗水与热血的残酷锦标赛。那些尝过败北滋味的人们，正用他们的执念，灼烧着深夜的球场。

prediction_results.question: ミオがカイトに持ちかけた提案とは？

prediction_results.question: 敗北を喫したカイト。次に彼が選ぶ道は？
